criteria.requirement: Current behavior, choice and consequence are immediately useful.
criteria.pass_when: Opening makes the limited result plus whole-input validation understandable, explains why stopping validation after N breaks the contract, and gives invalid-tail or equivalent decisive acceptance before lengthy history/process metadata.
criteria.fail_when: Current decision/consequence/example must be reconstructed from old history or the opening suggests stopping early; headings/word count alone do not establish success.

criteria.requirement: Preserve accepted behavior while making only the relevant design amendment.
criteria.pass_when: Retains source order/default/error behavior and accepted D1 history; describes limit validation and enough acceptance to implement; no code, speculative architecture or execution-state duplication.
criteria.fail_when: Drops whole-file validation or history, adds unrelated machinery, or turns design into code/test inventory.
